# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m156 and Linux fixes**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 updates to Skia m156 and restores Linux system-font discovery without bundled dependencies. It also adds native GTK4 GPU rendering with pixel scaling and updates Tizen native builds for GCC 14.2.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m156** — Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 156 and includes the current upstream engine changes. ([#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247), [#5208](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5208))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux system-font discovery restored without bundled dependencies** — Linux NoDependencies deployments can again discover installed system fonts. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))

## Platform

- **GTK4 gains native GPU rendering and pixel scaling** — GTK4 applications can use native GPU rendering with scaling that tracks the display pixel density. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))
- **Tizen native builds move to GCC 14.2** — Tizen 10 packages are built and validated with the GCC 14.2 toolchain. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))
